about.heading: Meet your stylist
about.text1: Aliona Boldișor runs a small, calm studio in Volintiri where every visit is one-on-one, with no rush and no walk-in queue. She is a qualified broad-profile hairdresser (frizer de profil larg) with professional training recognized in Moldova, including international certification.
about.text2: Aliona handles haircuts and color, nail care, and waxing herself, so you always see the same person. Appointments are by phone only; she blocks enough time for each client and keeps the studio private and discreet.

pricing.title: Transparent prices
pricing.intro: All prices in Moldovan lei (MDL). Call if you are unsure which service fits you.
pricing.note: Hair color: 100–150 MDL depending on length. Gel-lac price on request.

faq.title: Good to know before you visit
faq.intro: Quick answers. Call if something is not listed here.

booking.a: Call {phone} in advance. We do not take online bookings.

walkins.a: We work by appointment. Call to ask about same-day availability.

waxing.a: It varies by person. Regular sessions usually get easier. Let us know if you are nervous. We work at your pace.

hairColor.q: Can I bring my own hair dye?
hairColor.a: Yes. Coloring is done with your product; price depends on hair length and thickness.

privacy.a: Yes. What happens here stays confidential. Your comfort comes first.
